processing.regional_filter: Only level-4 polygon-matched OSM provinces and 3 cities of republican significance.

limitations: Not a complete KATO dataset; no official KATO IDs.
Admin polygon may be missing for incomplete OSM boundaries; city remains blank unless explicitly tagged or a valid polygon name matches nearest settlement node.
nearest_settlement is advisory only; do not silently treat it as verified city.
OSM way features may be repeated per street; join identical names only within verified place and provenance.
OSM PBF extract may include small border-area geometry; validate against Kazakhstan-specific boundaries before claiming national exhaustive accuracy.
Coordinates from way midpoint node, not exact feature geometry centroid.
Original OSM attribution and ODbL license must be retained.
Excluded OSM objects without a matching Kazakhstan level-4 administrative polygon; this favors precision over recall near border/geometry gaps.
City field for 3 cities of republican significance comes from verified admin-level-4 polygon containment.
Settlement place name deduplication can merge true homonyms inside the same district; retain places.csv for raw per-OSM identities.
Districts are derived from administrative names observed on geolocated OSM features; parent region is not a KATO-official code.
The region source is OSM administrative polygons, not the official KATO classifier.
